DDInter885.mechanism: The concomitant use of glucocorticoids may interfere with uptake of gallium citrate Ga-67 by brain tumors or abscesses. In addition, prednisone may cause thymic uptake of Ga-67.

DDInter975.mechanism: The concomitant use of certain medications (e.g., cytarabine, fluorouracil, methotrexate, and iron) may cause displacement of gallium citrate Ga-67 from plasma protein binding sites and interfere with test results.
